manifest.target: a pocket computer with a 5x5 LED screen, two buttons, and a handful of senses
provides: The device can feel its two front buttons and its touch logo, and can tell how bright the room is and how warm it is.
The device can feel how it is being moved: shaken, tilted, turned face up or face down, or dropped.
The device can light pixels on its screen, show pictures and scrolling text, and play sounds.
The device can send and receive radio messages to and from other devices on the same group.

inputKinds.name: button-a
inputKinds.description: Whether the A button is held down: true presses it, false releases it.

inputKinds.name: button-b
inputKinds.description: Whether the B button is held down: true presses it, false releases it.

inputKinds.name: gesture
inputKinds.description: How the device is being moved, named exactly: "shake", "freefall", "tilt up", "tilt down", "tilt left", "tilt right", "face up", "face down", or "none" to set it back down. A shake or a freefall plays once; a tilt or a face holds until another entry changes it. Either way it takes several thinks of being held before it is felt.

inputKinds.name: light-level
inputKinds.description: How bright the room is, from 0 (dark) to 255 (bright); a level outside that range is clamped.

inputKinds.name: logo-touch
inputKinds.description: Whether the touch logo is being touched: true holds the touch, false lets go.

inputKinds.name: radio-message-number
inputKinds.description: A number arriving over the radio, delivered once, on this think alone.

inputKinds.name: radio-message-string
inputKinds.description: A word arriving over the radio, delivered once, on this think alone; long text is cut short.

inputKinds.name: radio-signal-strength
inputKinds.description: How strong the radio messages after it come in, as -dBm: near 40 is close by and near 90 is far away. It holds until another entry changes it, and starts at 42.

inputKinds.name: temperature
inputKinds.description: How warm the device is, in whole degrees Celsius; it holds until another entry changes it.

stateChannels.name: display
stateChannels.description: What the 5x5 screen shows, as 25 brightness digits read left to right and top to bottom, one row after the next: 0 is off and 9 is full brightness, so `0000000900000000000000000` is one lit pixel in the middle.

stateChannels.name: speaker
stateChannels.description: The sound playing right now, as its name followed by `#` and a number that counts up each time a sound starts, or `idle` while nothing is playing.
